rationale: The agent located the user via find_user_id_by_name_zip and successfully updated the profile address to the requested New York address. However, the user explicitly asked to update “all possible order addresses,” and there is no evidence of any order-level address changes or of seeking confirmation for such order-changing actions. Later, when the user wanted to revert to the original Denver address but declined to provide the full street address, the agent appropriately handed off to a human, which aligns with policy when the request cannot be handled. Still, the overall request was not completed as stated, primarily due to not addressing the order addresses. There is no sign of acting on the wrong user or fabricating information, and no unconfirmed order-changing writes occurred because none were attempted. The failure is due to incomplete fulfillment of the user’s request.
